"""RoboPaint episode driver. All physical motions are archived in actions/.
Uses only the public client, RGB/depth cameras and robot proprioception.
Run supplied command files via: python gen.py command.py
"""
import sys,json,time,pathlib
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
ROOT=pathlib.Path('/app/output'); RUNS=pathlib.Path('/app/runs')
(ROOT/'actions').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
r=Robot(); spec=r.spec()
QUAT=np.array([-3.98743083e-7,1.,-3.55532393e-7,-2.86572686e-8])
statefile=ROOT/'driver_state.json'
state=json.loads(statefile.read_text()) if statefile.exists() else {'seq':0,'pose':[.00001343,0,.0931819,*QUAT]}

def submit(poses,note='',cameras=None,frames=False):
    a=np.asarray(poses,float)
    if a.ndim==1:a=a[None,:]
    if a.shape[1]==3:a=np.c_[a,np.tile(QUAT,(len(a),1))]
    out=None
    for i in range(0,len(a),190):
        chunk=a[i:i+190]; n=state['seq'];name=f'{n:04d}'
        np.save(ROOT/'actions'/f'{name}.npy',chunk)
        (ROOT/'actions'/f'{name}.json').write_text(json.dumps({'note':note,'dt':.05}))
        out=r.submit('ee_pose',chunk,dt=.05,cameras=cameras or ['practice_cam'],video='frames' if frames else 'none',video_fps=20 if frames else 1,note=note)
        out.save(str(RUNS/name))
        for cam,img in out.last.items():Image.fromarray(img).save(ROOT/f'latest_{cam}.png')
        state['seq']+=1;state['pose']=chunk[-1].tolist();statefile.write_text(json.dumps(state))
        print(name,'steps',out.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'),'tip',out.group('tcp_pose',now=True)[:3].round(6),'left',out.meta.get('time_left_s'), 'plan',out.meta.get('plan'),flush=True)
        if out.stopped or out.done:raise RuntimeError(out.meta)
    return out

def move(xyz,speed=.06,hold=.25,note='travel',cameras=None):
    start=np.array(state['pose'][:3]);xyz=np.array(xyz)
    n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(xyz-start)/speed/.05)))
    a=np.linspace(start,xyz,n+1)[1:]
    a=np.vstack([a,np.tile(xyz,(round(hold/.05),1))])
    return submit(a,note,cameras)

def observe(cameras=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],name='obs'):
    out=r.get_obs(cameras=cameras,depth=True);out.save(str(RUNS/name))
    for cam,img in out.last.items():Image.fromarray(img).save(ROOT/f'latest_{cam}.png')
    print('obs',out.meta['time_left_s'],out.group('tcp_pose',now=True),flush=True)
    return out

if __name__=='__main__' and len(sys.argv)>1:
    exec(compile(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(),sys.argv[1],'exec'))
PY","max_output_tokens":1000}));
